sn26.7:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave rūpasañcetanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || Yo dhammasañcetanāya uppādo ṭhiti || pe || jarā{maraṇassa} pātubhāvo || || Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpasañcetanāya nirodho vūpasamo || pe || Yo dhammasañcetanāya nirodho vūpasamo || jarāmaraṇassa atthagamo ti || || Sāvatthi || ||
